name: run_id
description: Run that produced this row. Part of the merge key and the first clustering column.

name: model_id
description: Model identifier the directions were fitted in.

name: condition
description: Context condition. Directions from different conditions are not pooled.

name: remove_top
description: Number of dominant background components projected out before fitting.

name: n_directions
description: Scale directions in this group. The hard ceiling on every dimensionality below: n directions span at most n dimensions, so these figures describe the selected scales, not semantics.

name: effective_dimensions
description: Participation ratio of the stacked directions' spectrum: a threshold-free effective dimensionality.

name: matched_null_dimensions
description: Mean effective dimensionality over shuffled-label replicates: the same items, contexts, preprocessing and fit, with only the ordering destroyed. A random-vector null would sit near n_directions and would claim far stronger evidence than exists, because a fitted direction necessarily lies in the row space of its own centred item matrix.

name: dimension_gap
description: matched_null_dimensions minus effective_dimensions. Positive means the fitted directions occupy fewer dimensions than the matched null, which is the evidence for sharing.

name: dimensions_90
description: Components needed to carry 90 percent of the spectral energy.

name: dimensions_99
description: Components needed to carry 99 percent. Equal to n_directions means no direction in the group is redundant.

name: mean_absolute_cosine
description: Mean absolute pairwise cosine between scale directions: how much they overlap at all, before any spectral summary.

name: half_split_cosine
description: Median absolute cosine between directions fitted on two disjoint halves of the contexts. A direction that depends on which contexts it saw is not a direction.

name: permutation_p
description: One-sided share of shuffled-label replicates whose effective dimensionality is at or below the observed one, plus one over replicates plus one. Floored at 1/(replicates+1), so with fifty replicates 0.0196 is the floor and not a measurement.
